overview.oneLineTake: Earnings and AI have equities back at records while yields cool, but the 5%+ rate and oil backdrop keeps the bid narrow and sensitive to today's Fed minutes.
themes: Records are back: the S&P 500 closed at its first record since August and the Nasdaq 100 rose about 0.5% (SPY 779.09, +0.55%; QQQ 759.66, +0.46%) as Q3 profit growth near 25% y/y anchors the earnings-season bid.

Rates relief, not a regime change: the 10y slipped about 3bp to ~5.28% off multi-decade highs, but traders are reloading bets on higher yields, December hike talk persists, and FOMC minutes land in today's US session.

Leadership is narrow and AI-heavy: Mag 7 and chips (Nvidia near $6T, Marvell raising its outlook, AMD at highs) carry the tape, the Nasdaq has beaten the Russell in 14 of 16 sessions, and the reported $40B SpaceX raise for Nvidia chips extends the capex story.

Energy stays the inflation channel: WTI ~$89.79, EIA lifted its 2026 Brent forecast to $98 ($105 Q4 average), Iran is stepping up Hormuz ship attacks even as flows recover, and diesel costs are prompting emergency policy moves.
Hedges are bid alongside equities: gold rose about 0.7% to ~$4,170 and the dollar sits near its strongest level of the year.
risks: Hawkish FOMC minutes or another long-end selloff (BNP warns axing the 20-year bond could push yields higher) would hit a narrow, rate-sensitive rally.
Hormuz or Iran escalation, with Vance demanding concrete nuclear concessions, could re-spike oil and diesel.
France's debt crisis and euro contagion fears, plus JPMorgan flagging distressed US loans at a post-pandemic high, are credit tail risks.
Thin breadth means a miss from a mega-cap leader can drag the index with little offset.

nq.summary: NDX printed a fresh record as the 10Y eased about 3bp and Q3 earnings hopes (~25% y/y) carried the tape. The close faded about 135 pts off the high, with semis rolling over late. Trend stays up, but tonight's auction plus minutes stack the rate risk into one window. Thesis: mildly bullish, 5/10 (brief rated Low-Med), buy dips in trend before the event and reduce into it. Invalidation: NDX close below 30,800. NDX levels: resistance 31,361 (record high), 31,500, 31,750; support 31,208, 31,117, 30,800.
nq.primaryCatalyst: US 10-year auction at 12:01 AM BKK Thursday, then FOMC minutes at 1:00 AM BKK Thursday.
nq.primaryRisk: Hawkish minutes, 10Y above 5.35%, or Hormuz escalation.
nq.overnight: NQ firm in a tight 31,485-31,521 band. FT says SpaceX wants $40B to buy Nvidia chips (after the close). WTI ~$89.8, gold ~$4,170.
nq.macro: 10Y off its highs but still 5.27%, and the 3Y auction cleared at 4.932%, the highest since 2006. A hawkish read in the minutes reprices December hike odds and hits long-duration tech first.
nq.volatility: VIX 15.0 (-3.3%), VXN 21.1 (-2.5%). Vol eased with price, but VXN stays rich versus VIX. Dealer gamma unavailable.
